concern: (low) Navigation link tap targets in header should ensure a minimum of 44x44px interactive area on mobile touch interfaces per Fitts's Law.
jtbd: When I navigate the application on a mobile touch device, I want navigation links to have a minimum 44x44px touch target, so that I do not trigger unintended actions or miss the link.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a mobile viewport (<= 768px), When inspecting the touch target bounding box of header navigation items (<nav role="navigation"> a), Then each link interactive area measures at least 44x44px.
editInstruction: In header nav a elements, ensure a minimum interactive target size of 44x44px on mobile viewports by adding responsive classes such as 'inline-flex items-center justify-center min-w-[44px] min-h-[44px] md:min-w-0 md:min-h-0' while preserving existing typography and hover styles.

concern: (low) Hero media element references assets/images/knowledge-base-crie-hero.webp which should be verified for lazy loading and fallback display when assets are loading.
jtbd: When loading the page over varying network conditions, I want the hero media element to specify loading strategy and layout dimensions with graceful fallback styling, so that layout shift (CLS) is prevented and loading behavior remains stable.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the hero media preview image, When the mockup renders, Then the tag includes explicit width/height or aspect-ratio attributes, an alt attribute describing the preview, and appropriate loading attributes (loading="eager" for LCP hero or background fallback placeholder container) preventing layout shifts.
